businesses.customers: Vehicle owners in South River, Milltown and surrounding Middlesex County, plus insurer-referred collision work (the site has a dedicated insurance-questions page).

size_signals.signal: Operating since 1939
4.2 from Google reviews; profile category 'Auto body shop' with hours listed
Shop hours Mon-Thu 7:30-5, Fri 7:30-4, closed weekends; loaner car offered per a published testimonial

listing.reviews: count not shown in the Maps view I opened

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: none on the website — but the Google profile has a 'Book online' button that opens a Carwise appointment page for this shop
website_review.trust_signals: Since 1939, customer testimonials, before/after gallery, shop photos, AutoRepair schema with phone, address and price range
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Template site (repairshopwebsites.com) whose H1 is 'WE NOW ACCEPT ALL CREDIT CARDS!'; contact page has no form, only an address and phone
website_review.search_basics: Title names auto body repair and South River; there is a Milltown landing page plus service pages for collision, paint, towing and A/C, and AutoRepair JSON-LD with address, phone and price range
top_issues: Contact page offers no form or email — a customer can only phone
No appointment/estimate intake on the site, despite the Google profile pointing to Carwise booking
H1 is an announcement about credit cards, not the service

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: claimed profile with category, hours, address and a 'Book online' action. Answerable: AutoRepair JSON-LD with phone, address and price range; services and hours are real text on site. Bookable: an agent can reach a Carwise appointment page from the Google listing, but knoblocksnj.com itself has no form or booking, and the shop's drivability intake is a PDF (defaults/files/DrivabilityForm.pdf).

operations_signals.signal: Customer intake for drivability issues is a downloadable PDF form — manual, paper-style workflow
Insurance questions are handled through a separate page rather than a structured claim-intake flow
Booking exists only via a third-party Carwise page reached from Google, not from the shop's own site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Put an estimate/photo-upload intake and the Carwise booking link directly on the site so damage photos and insurance details arrive before the customer calls
top_opportunities.evidence: Website has 0 forms; contact page says only 'contact us at the address and phone number'; the drivability form is a PDF

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the H1 and add a repair-status/photo update flow for waiting customers and insurers
top_opportunities.evidence: H1 reads 'WE NOW ACCEPT ALL CREDIT CARDS!'; testimonials praise being 'finished when promised', which implies status questions are a recurring load

top_opportunities.opportunity: Review growth from 4.2 (weakest rating in the batch) with automatic post-repair review requests
top_opportunities.evidence: Google shows 4.2 for Knoblock's versus 4.8-5.0 for the electricians and showroom in this batch

scores.reasons: Gap 3: template site with no form, but schema, tel links, service pages and third-party booking already exist. Ability 3: collision repair carries decent tickets but the shop is a single location with 4.2 stars. Ease 4: form/booking embed plus H1 fix is quick. Evidence 4: site pages, schema, contact page and profile checked; it is in South River, not Milltown.

caveats: Google Maps served a limited view for most listings, so review counts were only readable where Google rendered them (Hollander 207, Diamond 195, Anytime 28). All other counts are marked as not shown rather than guessed.

Several page titles came back with a leading emoji character in document.title across unrelated platforms (Duda, Weebly, Wix, Netlify, template). Because it spans unrelated builders it may be a title-rendering quirk of the browser rather than literal markup; the substantive Hollander finding is that its title contains no readable text at all.

Batch addresses were unreliable: Sam's Kitchen & Bath is at 262 Ryders Ln (not 380), Continental Pools' site says 134 N. Main St while Google says 26 Highland Dr, Garden State Pool Care sits on Lawrence Brook Dr in East Brunswick rather than Milltown, and Knoblock's Auto Body is in South River.

Phone numbers in batch.json were sometimes missing or different from live data (Anytime Plumbing 732-387-5187 vs 732-238-8788 in directories; Continental Pools listed as unknown but Google shows 732-543-2737; LGH Electric listed as unknown but Google shows 732-672-6464).
Only four businesses got a 390 px mobile screenshot (Hollander, Sam's, Rylee, Diamond); for the rest, phone layout was judged from tel: link presence and page structure rather than a mobile render.
Roughly five minutes per business per the brief: no deep SEO crawl, backlink or competitor audit. No forms were submitted anywhere.
data_gaps: Google review counts for Rylee, Garden State Pool Care, Continental Pools, Awesome Painter, LGH Electric, Sam's Kitchen & Bath and Knoblock's Auto Body were not displayed in the limited Maps view.

Anytime Plumbing's website (milltownplumbers.com, the URL on both Google listings) timed out repeatedly on https and http, so its robots.txt, schema, forms and mobile layout could not be assessed at all.
Could not confirm whether LGH Electric's Google profile is claimed; Google shows 'Add website' and 'Add missing information' prompts, which suggests it is not, but that is an inference.
Rylee Home Services' Google profile lists callrylee.com as the website while the search result and site footer use ryleehomeservices.com; whether both resolve to the same content was not verified.
No employee counts, revenue figures or job postings were found for any business in this batch, so size is judged from licences, locations, review volume and staff named on site.
